coarse_space.R_solve: general dense solve; no symmetry assumption
coarse_space.basis_storage_precision: double generation rounded to float32 as source host upload then widened
coarse_space.source_geometry: captured accepted rest_m; source preconditioner region bits from tet_flags; same operator free mask

gmres_restart16.method: custom right-preconditioned restarted GMRES(16), twice-reorthogonalized modified Gram-Schmidt; true unpreconditioned residual b-A*x recomputed in binary64 each inner iteration

limits: Only selected environment 0 free mechanical xyz block; field backing, env1, rigid/contact/cohesive rows excluded.
A is reconstructed from native FP32 tangent cache in binary64, not re-evaluated material law or native GPU action.
P reproduces the source rigid translations/rotations but omits optional bending enrichments and is not a capture of exact production P/AP/RAP.
H is exact same-generation captured right scale; GMRES with fixed H is not native CGLS/FGMRES replay.
All methods use the same A, b, x0 and binary64 residual history; no acceptance tolerance/gate is altered.
Exact LU is a numerical reference for this captured matrix only, not nonlinear convergence or physical assembly qualification.

operator.definition: A=M+dt^2 K from exact captured FP32 algorithmic tangent; assembled once in binary64 for all methods
operator.initial_guess: captured original Newton correction x0; solve remaining residual b-A*x0
operator.rhs: captured same-generation base_residual_rhs on free xyz rows

preconditioners.captured_block3: M=H, exact same-generation captured per-node 3x3 right_scale_rows on free xyz
preconditioners.source_block_RAP_two_level: M(r)=P c + H(r-AP c), c=(P^T A P)^-1 P^T r; exact algebraic form of nm_fgmres_regional_apply_block_rap with the captured block H and source rigid P; AP and RAP recomputed in binary64 from the same A

source_binding.basis_algorithm: runtime.mm buildRegionalGalerkinBasis rigid 6 modes per compact region; volume-overlap weights, two-pass modified Gram-Schmidt; rest geometry and region tags are from exact capture; optional global bending enrichment omitted

verdict: CPU-only fixed-cached-operator Krylov comparison; no native preconditioner execution, no physical qualification
